The '''Vanarian Tree Eater''' was a type of creature<ref name="GH" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Vanaria system/Legends|Vanaria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had a tail the end of which resembled a small, cute-looking [[Alien/Legends|alien]].<ref name="GH" />

{{RPGseed}}
At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of individuals encountered a Vanarian Tree Eater, initially mistaking its tail end for a small-sized being.<ref name="GH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Vanarian Tree Eater was introduced in ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the creature was mentioned in a hypothetical scenario used to illustrate how the gamemaster player utilizing elements of surprise could enrich the game experience for the other players. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GH" />
